jobs.title: Head of Market Research | AI-Native Research (Remote US/EU)
jobs.jd_full:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

About the Role

Maze is launching a Market Research service that blends the scale and speed of our platform with expert led research services, creating an AI-native alternative to traditional market research agencies.

As Head of Market Research, you'll be the founding research leader for this new line of business. Reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with the Head of GTM, Research Services, you'll define what great market research looks like for the next generation of insights organizations. You'll own the research vision, methodologies, service delivery, and quality bar while helping shape the future of research alongside Product, Engineering, and GTM.

This is a rare opportunity to build a modern market research organization from the ground up. We're looking for someone with deep methodological expertise, a strong point of view on where the industry is headed, and the curiosity to rethink how research can evolve alongside new technologies and changing customer expectations.

You'll thrive here if you're equal parts practitioner, builder, and innovator—someone who has spent years earning credibility in market research and is now excited to redefine what the next generation of research can become.

What You'll Do

Research Strategy & Service Design

  • Define the long-term vision for Maze's Market Research service and establish what best-in-class research looks like in an AI-native world.

  • Design and evolve our research methodologies across qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-method studies.

  • Partner closely with the Head of GTM to shape service offerings, ensuring our commercial strategy is grounded in exceptional research quality.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and evolving research practices to continuously improve how research is designed, delivered, and synthesized.

Build the Research Function

  • Build and lead the Market Research organization, establishing the operating model, delivery processes, quality standards, and hiring strategy.

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of researchers as the business scales.

  • Create repeatable systems that allow Maze to deliver exceptional research with greater speed, consistency, and efficiency than traditional agencies.

  • Establish quality assurance frameworks while balancing methodological rigor with the agility our customers expect.

Research Delivery & Customer Partnership

  • Serve as the executive research lead on strategic customer engagements, ensuring every project delivers meaningful business outcomes.

  • Guide study design, research approaches, analysis, and executive storytelling for our highest-impact customers.

  • Partner with customers to understand complex business problems and translate them into actionable research strategies.

  • Continuously improve our delivery model based on customer feedback and market evolution.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to help shape the future of Maze's research capabilities and ensure our platform continues to meet the evolving needs of research teams.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our research expertise is reflected throughout the customer journey.

  • Help establish Maze as a trusted authority in the market research industry through customer conversations, industry events, publications, and thought leadership.

  • Act as the voice of the researcher internally, ensuring product and commercial decisions remain grounded in customer insight and research excellence.

Who You Are

Experience

  • Significant experience leading market research teams, research consulting practices, or insights organizations.

  • Deep expertise across qualitative and quantitative methodologies, research design, sampling, analysis, and insight generation.

  • Experience building or scaling research organizations, practices, or service offerings.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to advise senior leaders and enterprise customers on research strategy.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally across commercial, product, and operational teams.

Skills & Strengths

Research visionary

You have a clear perspective on where market research is heading and enjoy building new capabilities, services, and ways of working that help customers make better decisions.

Future-focused

You have a point of view on where market research is heading and are excited by how new technologies—including AI—can improve the way research is designed, delivered, and consumed. You're curious, adaptable, and eager to help shape what's next for the industry.

Builder

You thrive in zero-to-one environments. You're comfortable creating structure from ambiguity, building teams, and establishing entirely new ways of working.

Methodology expert

You're respected for your research expertise and know when to challenge conventional approaches. You balance methodological rigor with practical business outcomes.

Executive partner

You communicate complex research clearly, influence senior stakeholders, and build trusted relationships across customers, executives, and cross-functional teams.

Bonus

  • Experience modernizing research organizations through new technologies, automation, or innovative research practices.

  • Experience launching a new research practice, consultancy, or service line.

  • Public speaking, publishing, or thought leadership within the market research industry.

  • Experience working across both agency and client-side research organizations.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams to build research technology.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture.

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

jobs.title: Contract Senior Staff Product Manager (US - East)
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

All organizations need security testing for their software and we are building the world’s largest and smartest pentest management platform to help solve this challenge at scale.

As a Contract Senior Staff Product Manager, you will drive the definition, delivery, and adoption of new product features and ecosystem integrations. You will be responsible for taking the lead of our next gen deliverables, from user discovery and roadmap prioritization to go-to-market execution - ensuring that our platform evolves to solve the most pressing challenges in the security workflow.

This is a full-time contractor position providing hourly coverage from October through the end of February. In this role, you will merge attention to detail with the ability to understand and align business objectives, while working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to drive customer insights and inputs directly into the development process. You will work closely with our other Customer Experience and Pentester Experience teams.

What You Would Do

As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include:

  • Rapidly acquire new technical knowledge while maintaining meticulous attention to detail. Champion the strategic product direction across the organization, ensuring internal and external synchronization while serving as a subject matter expert on industry developments and defensive security operations.
  • Represent our customers. Work with Product Design, Product Marketing, Sales and Customer Success teams to bring the customer’s voice into the development process.
  • Manage the platform next-gent feature deliverables . Make tough tactical prioritization decisions while enabling the company to think long-term.
  • Collaborate across teams. We win or lose as a team. Product managers are a critical role in creating alignment between engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Have familiarity with information security, security operations, vulnerability disclosure, vulnerability management and other security domain areas.
  • Become an expert in pentesting best practices. You are ready to discuss and demonstrate product details with developers, product designers, security operations, pentesters, customers and sales prospects.
  • Measure success. Own the measures used to define success for your product. Success measures must be defined at the inception of a product and tracked throughout its lifecycle. Make measures visible to all stakeholders and interpret them into actionable conclusions and new hypotheses.
  • Lead Go-to-Market (GTM) Readiness: Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to orchestrate successful feature launches. Develop launch strategies, create internal training materials, and support the creation of customer-facing collateral to ensure seamless adoption.
  • Maintain technical fluency in the operational workflows of modern cybersecurity tools, including vulnerability management or offensive security platforms. Evaluate how these tools function within a customer’s security environment to inform product development.

You Must Have

  • 8+ years experience in Product Management and 3+ years experience in cybersecurity tools (vulnerability management or offensive security platforms), with a demonstrated ability to discover new opportunities and then define and deliver products. Experience in fast-growing software companies is a plus.
  • Strong technical skills - you can work alongside customers to help debug and improve our integration offerings.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder empathy. You must not only be the voice of the customer but at various times the voice of marketing, finance, engineering, sales and customer success. You must be able to channel many points of view.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You’re great at explaining highly technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences, with a talent for building empathy for user problems.
  • Strong analytical capabilities is a plus.
  • Strong bias for action, creative thinking, innovation and data-driven product decision-making.
  • A can-do attitude and ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with agile software development.
  • Experience working with global team members (This team is a global team).
  • Hands-on experience with core cybersecurity tooling (e.g., DAST/SAST scanners, vulnerability management systems, or pentest workflow platforms). Articulate how security teams utilize these tools to identify, prioritize, and remediate risk, understanding the "why" behind the tooling workflow beyond simple API integrations.
  • Strong technical and product communication skills: Ability to translate complex security concepts into clear documentation, user guides, and release notes tailored to both technical developers and business stakeholders.
  • Full-time availability for the duration of the contract. You must be able to commit to full-time hourly coverage from October through the end of February, with no planned extended absences or vacations during the contract period (excluding recognized company holiday’s).

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The hourly range for this role is $84 - $106. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

Cobalt is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is an Internet-based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA). It allows participating employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States.

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Neobank App
jobs.jd_full:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Ireland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Ireland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager — AI
jobs.jd_full:
Description

ueni.com is looking for a Technical Product Manager with a strong focus on artificial intelligence to help shape and deliver technically ambitious products for our business customers.

This role is ideal for someone who can bridge product, engineering, and leadership: translating medium-level specifications into practical solutions, exploring new technologies independently, and making thoughtful decisions about how AI should be designed and deployed.

What you’ll do

  • Define, prioritise, and manage AI-focused product initiatives from discovery through delivery.

  • Understand AI modelling concepts and evaluate the trade-offs between local, cloud, and hybrid processing.

  • Help design and assess technical workflows involving image processing, automation, data handling, and AI-powered features.

  • Test experimental solutions, prototypes, and emerging tools independently.

  • Assess feasibility, risks, performance, cost, scalability, and user impact.

  • Challenge assumptions and push back constructively when a proposed approach is unclear, inefficient, or unlikely to deliver the desired outcome.

  • Create clear product documentation, specifications, acceptance criteria, and priorities.

  • Coordinate delivery across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Monitor outcomes and use feedback, data, and experimentation to improve products over time.

Requirements

  • Approximately 5–10 years of experience in product management, technical product management, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of AI and machine-learning concepts, including the ability to work effectively with technical specialists.

  • Experience evaluating or delivering AI-powered products, automation, image-processing workflows, or similar technical systems.

  • Ability to understand and discuss technical architecture, APIs, data flows, model limitations, and deployment choices.

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.

  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and turning broad requirements into actionable plans.

  • A highly autonomous working style, with the curiosity to investigate and test solutions independently.

  • Confidence communicating with senior leadership and engineering teams.

  • Willingness to challenge ideas constructively and make evidence-based recommendations.

  • You must be able to work effectively with distributed international teams and communicate fluently in English.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Remote
jobs.jd_full:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto’s extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don’t wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren’t built by sitting together, they’re built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

Where you’ll leave your mark?

  • Own Sprinto’s AI browser extensions and AI features end to end — one of several streams within our AI pod, alongside accuracy baselining and automations — as its business owner, not just its product manager.
  • Define the problem statement from first principles — figure out what’s worth building, why, and for whom, before a line of code is written.
  • Build the product and take it to first customers — work hands-on with an initial set of customers, one on one, to get it to a successful POC stage.
  • Drive distribution and adoption — partner with CX, Sales, and Marketing to take what worked in POCs to wider launch and measurable adoption across the customer base.
  • Own accuracy and quality for AI-driven features — set the bar, know the pitfalls of building on non-deterministic systems, and keep improving output reliability post-launch.
  • Operate with senior-level autonomy — set direction for this stream, make calls without waiting for a mandate, and be accountable for outcomes, not deliverables.

The kind of builder we’re looking for -

  • 3–5 years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • A business-owner mindset — you think in terms of customer outcomes, adoption, and impact, not tickets shipped.
  • A strong first-principles, structured thinker — able to break down an ambiguous problem space and build a clear path from idea to launch.
  • Hands-on with customers — comfortable running discovery, POCs, and feedback loops directly with early users to make them successful.
  • A strong cross-functional collaborator — you’ve taken products from build to go-to-market by working closely with CX, Sales, and Marketing.
  • AI product experience is a strong plus, not a requirement — if you’ve built AI-powered features, you know how to improve accuracy and avoid the common pitfalls; if you haven’t, you should be able to reason your way there.
  • Comfortable with a fast, high-ownership environment — this role exists because we need someone who can pick up a stream and run with it.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Appspace:

At Appspace, we’re passionate about creating better work experiences for people everywhere, and we’re looking for people that feel the same way. Our global office locations and flexible work culture help you work wherever and however you’re at your best. Plus, we take the time to help you enjoy your work, build lasting connections, and grow your role. Join the Appspace team and be a part of a culture that’s helping people everywhere love where they work.

The Role

This is a product role for a Senior PM who brings both technical expertise and experience in Digital Signage. The scope spans active delivery ownership, platform-level technical judgment, and strategic product decisions across within the Digital Signage product as well as the intersection of Digital Signage with employee comms capabilities throughout the platform. Working within the AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), this role operates at the intersection of product strategy, engineering depth, and cross-platform coherence. The business outcomes are ARR growth, customer adoption, and delivery quality across the platform.

What You’ll Own

  • Own strategic product decisions for the current product line: how it should be structured, what needs to be fixed or refactored, and how it advances the broader Appspace product strategy.
  • Engage engineering at the level of platform architecture and core frameworks, bringing technical judgment that shapes product decisions across the platform.
  • Apply the AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) from discovery through delivery, treating AI as a product design tool, a development accelerator, and a feature layer.
  • Own the adoption and correct application of platform frameworks within the current product line, identifying gaps, misuse, or missed leverage across the codebase and roadmap.
  • Take ownership of platform-level initiatives and features that cross product lines or sit at the foundation of the Appspace platform, alongside current product line delivery.
  • Own roadmap execution including prioritization, escalation management, and delivery quality across engineering cycles.
  • Drive ARR growth through new customer acquisition, expansion, and retention, connecting roadmap decisions to adoption and business outcomes.
  • Translate customer escalations and support signals into prioritized product decisions, distinguishing bugs, product gaps, and adoption issues.
  • Run structured customer discovery to validate priorities and surface needs not visible in feature requests or support queues.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to keep the current product line coherent with the broader platform architecture and AI strategy.
  • Represent the product line in cross-functional execution with GTM, Customer Success, and Engineering across global teams in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Build context on new product lines quickly and apply the same technical rigor and strategic judgment across the platform as organizational needs shift.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, with a track record of owning delivery on complex, technically involved product lines.
  • Market experience delivery digital signage products including experience developing and managing partner integrations.
  • Technical depth. Engages on platform architecture and core frameworks at the level of engineering, not just product oversight.
  • AIDLC experience. Demonstrated experience working within an AI development framework.
  • Delivery ownership. Track record of managing roadmaps under pressure, handling escalations, and shipping outcomes that moved business metrics.
  • Strategic judgment. Able to assess how a product line should be structured, what needs to be fixed or refactored, and how individual decisions connect to broader product strategy.
  • ARR focus. Connects product decisions to new logo acquisition, expansion, and retention. Measures success by business impact.
  • Customer focus. Runs discovery, reads support data, and makes prioritization decisions based on evidence.
  • Platform fluency. Has worked on products where understanding the underlying architecture directly shaped product decisions.
  • Clear communication. Keeps cross-functional teams aligned and communicates effectively with customers, engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.

The Perks of Working for Appspace:

For all our US based team members, we offer a variety of benefits from competitive salaries, medical, dental and vision coverage, disability coverage, employer paid life insurance, mental health resources, 401(k) plan and a fully paid parental leave program.

Additional perks include:

  • Generous PTO
  • Flexible work schedules
  • Remote work opportunities
  • Paid company holidays
  • Appspace Quiet Fridays (No non-essential internal meetings scheduled)
  • A casual dress work environment

Disclaimer:

Appspace is committed to equitable compensation practices and complies with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations. For jurisdictions that require pay scale disclosure, a general compensation range may be provided during the initial stages of the interview process. Final compensation will be based on multiple factors including experience, skills, certifications, and overall fit for the role.

If you are located in a jurisdiction with specific pay transparency requirements, we will be happy to discuss the relevant range during your application process.

jobs.title: Director, Product Strategy and Operations  - Mexico
jobs.jd_full:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the Role:

Mission: Give the Product leadership team a reliable operating system connecting strategy, investment, execution, customer evidence, adoption, packaging, and business performance.

Role profile: Director-level, reporting directly to the SVP Product. Capable of operating as a highly hands-on leader.

What you’ll be doing:

jobs.title: Lead Delivery Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.

We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

The Role:

As a Lead Delivery Manager, you lead delivery of our most complex, high-visibility client implementations across ERP, MES/WMS, CRM and related Datacor solutions. You independently own scope, budget, risk, and stakeholder management, coordinate cross-functional teams of implementation specialists, technical services, and solution architects, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. We guide our clients through every stage of their life cycle, be it acquisitions, disposals, management buy-outs, buy-ins, mergers and strategic reviews, and in this role you help set the standard for how Datacor delivers.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for delivering Datacor’s most complex, high-visibility client implementations across diverse industries.
  • Own planning and scheduling for complex, multi-workstream deliveries, including scope, milestones, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Manage budget, resourcing, and risk for large projects, including forecasting, change control, and contingency planning.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across implementation, technical services, solution architecture, and product/development to keep deliveries aligned and on track.
  • Conduct executive status meetings and manage senior stakeholder relationships, presenting delivery health, risks, and recommendations clearly and persuasively.
  • Drive resolution of complex customer inquiries, complaints, and escalations related to delivery, including scope and commercial discussions.
  • Understand the key business drivers of each client and anticipate issues and risks before they affect the delivery, using insights, factual conclusions, and advice.
  • Negotiate requirements, scope changes, and alternative solutions with client leadership and internal teams.
  • Identify and champion improvements to delivery methodology, templates, and tools, building consensus and support for new delivery approaches.
  • Maintain broad relationships across Datacor (Sales, Optimization, Support, and Product) and with key clients to support smooth handoffs and long-term account health.
  • Stay current on ERP trends, technologies, and best practices in process manufacturing and distribution.

As a Lead Delivery Manager, you are a senior individual contributor and a role model for the delivery team. This role does not carry formal direct reports, but you are expected to raise the performance of the people around you. As part of this role, you will:

  • Coach, review, and delegate work to Sr. Delivery Managers and Project Managers, providing guidance and feedback on delivery practices
  • Mentor newer delivery staff on planning, risk management, and executive communication
  • Serve as the go-to resource for the team’s hardest delivery problems, leading others to resolve them
  • Foster a team culture that drives continuous improvement, finding incremental improvements in processes and projects
  • Model customer-focused behavior, setting expectations for positive relationship building with internal and external customers

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, accounting, finance, computer science or relevant area; a combination of education and relevant work experience will be considered.
  • Minimum 5-7 years’ experience in ERP software delivery or implementation, including leading complex, multi-workstream projects
  • Proven track record of delivering large implementations on time and on budget
  • Experience with ERP, MES/WMS, or CRM implementations in process manufacturing or distribution preferred
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring a fresh perspective to complex delivery challenges
  • Advanced organizational, project management, and budget management skills
  • Exceptional time management skills across multiple concurrent engagements
  • Superb computer literacy with business software, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and project management tools
  • PMP or equivalent project management certification a plus
  • Demonstrated success coaching, reviewing, and delegating work to other delivery or project staff
  • Highly skilled at presenting complex information to senior-level audiences, negotiating solutions, and building consensus
  • Recognized as a trusted delivery leader by clients and internal stakeholders
  • Communicates directly, delivers clear feedback and direction, and inspires others

EOE Statement:

Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Use of AI During Interviews:

At Datacor, we value thoughtful problem-solving and authentic perspectives. We’re interested in hearing your experience, your approach, and how you think through challenges.

jobs.title: Project Manager III
jobs.jd_full:
The Senior Project Manager / Delivery Lead operates as a trusted, high-impact leader responsible for driving Modea’s most complex enterprise engagements, specifically focusing on multi-phase Enterprise Web Modernization initiatives. This role demands an advanced balance of deep agile product development expertise, proactive risk management, and executive-level client advisory.

In this role, you will lead cross-functional delivery teams through end-to-end digital transformations, owning scope, schedule, budget, staffing, and multi-vendor alignment. As the primary bridge between technical delivery and client leadership, you will proactively anticipate risks, guide organizational change management, and manage client stakeholder expectations to ensure flawless execution and strategic alignment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  1. ### Project Leadership & Risk Planning
  • Spot and Fix Risks Early: Find technical and project risks before they turn into real problems. Ask hard questions, address bottlenecks, and build clear backup plans to protect project budgets and schedules.
  • Guide Clients Through Change: Partner directly with client leaders to help their organizations adapt to new web platforms and tools. Keep everyone aligned on scope, trade-offs, and shifting business priorities.
  • Oversee Large Enterprise Web Modernization Engagements: Lead teams through major website rebuilds and migrations, including content moves and design system rollouts.
  1. ### Agile Product Development & Delivery
  • Use Agile Practices: Guide internal teams and clients through agile software development, making sure work is clear and structured.
  • Manage Plans in Jira: Use Jira and Jira Advanced Plans to map out work across multiple teams, spot team dependencies, track capacity, and give clients accurate completion estimates.
  • Deliver Quality on Schedule: Work with Product Owners and technical leads to maintain project backlogs, plan software releases, and deliver high-quality work on time.
  • Control Budgets and Scope: Track project spending and team hours. Take action early if costs start running over budget so projects stay profitable.
  1. ### Team Empowerment & Executive Communication
  • Cross-Functional Team Leadership: Lead, align, and motivate cross-functional  teams (Solutions Architects, Digital Strategists, Product Designers, Quality Analysts, Data Analysts), to foster a high-performance, collaborative delivery environment.
  • Communicate Clearly with Executives: Give concise, plain-language project updates and presentations to client executives and senior leaders.
  • Mentorship & Practice Growth: Elevate internal project management standards by coaching team members, refining delivery frameworks, and sharing best practices across the organization.

Critical Competencies:

  • Risk Planning: You can find potential issues across complex technical projects early and know how to fix them before they disrupt work. You are comfortable having direct, honest conversations with clients and internal leadership.
  • Client & Change Management: You build trust quickly, navigate client office politics, and help teams adapt to new systems and processes smoothly.
  • Jira & Planning Expertise: You have practical experience using Jira and Jira Advanced Plans to create multi-team roadmaps, track dependencies, and manage team workloads.
  • Agile Software Development: You know how modern software gets built using lean and agile frameworks. You know how to run sprint planning, backlog refinement, and software releases.
  • Technical Understanding: You understand basic modern web setups, enterprise Digital Experience Platforms (DXP)), API integrations, and cloud hosting. You do not need to write code, but you must understand how technical teams build web platforms.
  • Clear Communication: You can break down complex technical topics into simple terms that business leaders understand.
  • Budget Tracking: You know how to track project costs, spot spending variances, and adjust plans to protect margins.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Required Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is strictly required.
  • 7+ years of progressive project/product management experience leading complex technology engagements in a client-facing or agency setting.
  • Enterprise Modernization Track Record: Proven history of leading large-scale enterprise web redesigns, platform modernizations, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Tooling Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of Jira and Jira Advanced Plans for roadmapping, dependency mapping, and release tracking.
  • Agile Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban/SAFe) within modern software engineering environments.
  • Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) required.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Agile Certifications: CSM, CSPO, or PMI-ACP certifications.
  • Atlassian Admin Experience: Experience configuring Jira and Confluence setups.
  • DXP & Sitecore AI Architecture: Experience with Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), specifically Sitecore AI, Headless Sitecore (XM Cloud), and modern frontend or API frameworks.
  • Design Systems: Experience managing projects that build and use modular design systems, including atomic design workflows.
  • Healthcare Domain: Experience delivering digital solutions within healthcare or other heavily regulated enterprise landscapes.

Who is Modea?

We are a technology consultancy with a mission to infuse greater control, transparency, and choice into the consumer healthcare experience. To do this, we work with large healthcare providers to help them build out a digital roadmap, then design and build mobile, web, and other digital experiences. We fundamentally believe that this work helps consumers have better information and access to care, and our clients to build stronger customer relationships.

Here are a few ways to get to know our work in healthcare:

  • Learn about our award-winningEHR-integrated mobile app development for Children’s Wisconsin. This app delivers a fully integrated MyChart to allow parents to manage their children’s health in one place.
  • Discover Luminis Health’swebsite development that was built with a firm accessibility standard and patient-centric solutions.
  • If you’re interested in learning more, we encourage you to dive into some of ourother work.

Here are a few other reasons why you should apply:

First, you’ll love the work we do and the people you’ll get to do it with. We’ve assembled an exceptionally smart and hardworking team and you’ll enjoy the work associations and general camaraderie with other “Modeans.” We also work with great clients who value our contributions and work side-by-side with us.

Second, Modea offers a great benefits package that provides both a fun and enjoyable workplace and great perks that will improve your quality of life:

  • Generous paid time off
  • Generous health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401k with fully vested company matching

Some of these benefits, like parties and snacks, have had to adapt to the remote work environment we are currently in, but our operations team has found innovative ways to support our employees. We take care of our team.

Actual starting compensation may vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, specific skills, internal equity considerations, and business needs.

Work environment:

jobs.title: Project Manager - Construction & ERRCS
jobs.jd_full:
Position Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptionally organized and process-driven Project Manager to manage commercial and industrial ERRCS (Emergency Responder Radio Coverage Systems) projects from bid through final closeout. You will coordinate project documentation, construction requirements, contractors, vendors, customers, engineers, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs). You will manage multiple projects simultaneously, track deadlines and requirements, prepare and submit documentation, and ensure each project progresses smoothly from quote through completion. This role is ideal for someone with U.S. commercial construction project management experience who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with construction documents, permits, contractors, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Contract & Estimating

  • Review and log incoming bid requests in the project management/CRM system.
  • Review construction plans, drawings, specifications, and project manuals.
  • Research and document project requirements, including construction type, square footage, stories, taxes, warranties, maintenance agreements, insurance, bonds, and other requirements.
  • Research local AHJ requirements, fire codes, ERRCS policies, radio systems, frequencies, and permit requirements.
  • Coordinate with AHJs to confirm enforcement, testing, plan review, permitting, and inspection requirements.
  • Research contractor licensing and registration requirements.
  • Support budgetary pricing and prepare project quotes.
  • Maintain accurate project information and documentation in CRM and shared systems.

Contract Award & Vendor Coordination

  • Review contracts and identify unusual or inconsistent requirements.
  • Coordinate RFQs with RF engineers, installers, equipment distributors, and other vendors.
  • Review system designs, vendor quotes, and Bills of Materials for accuracy and completeness.
  • Coordinate pricing for equipment, electrical, fire alarm, roofing, and other project requirements.
  • Track sales tax, shipping, warranties, maintenance agreements, and other project costs.
  • Maintain executed contracts and project records.

Pre-Installation Documentation

  • Prepare, format, organize, and distribute project submittals to customers, installers, and AHJs.
  • Coordinate building plans, certifications, permits, equipment documentation, system designs, reports, and trade coordination documents.
  • Prepare and maintain installer work orders and project documentation.
  • Collect and verify vendor W-9s, COIs, OSHA certifications, and other required credentials.
  • Coordinate customer-specific requirements such as insurance, background checks, drug testing, badging, and certifications.
  • Confirm project and contractor licensing or permit requirements.

AHJ & Permit Coordination

  • Submit project documentation to AHJs for formal plan review when required.
  • Coordinate BDA transmission requests with applicable radio system administrators.
  • Apply for required fire or building permits.
  • Track plan reviews, radio approvals, permits, and inspections.
  • Follow up with AHJs and relevant authorities to keep approvals moving.
  • Maintain accurate records of regulatory and permitting requirements.

Installation & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate with technical services, installers, trades, customers, and vendors throughout the project.
  • Track equipment orders and delivery schedules.
  • Coordinate responses to changes in building plans, construction timelines, and project requirements.
  • Follow up on outstanding tasks, approvals, documents, and deliverables.
  • Maintain project timelines and ensure stakeholders remain informed.
  • Identify and resolve project issues before they impact deadlines.

Post-Installation & Closeout

  • Prepare and distribute final project closeout documentation.
  • Maintain system manuals and post-installation documentation.
  • Coordinate commissioning reports, signal test reports, warranties, installation photos, and as-built system designs.
  • Confirm completion of installer and trade coordination requirements.
  • Coordinate project invoicing and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up on lien waivers from installers and suppliers when required.
  • Ensure projects are fully documented and properly closed.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Maintain and improve standardized project management processes, templates, and systems.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve project workflows.
  • Build and maintain organized documentation systems.
  • Support automation initiatives to improve project tracking, reporting, and communication.
  • Continuously identify ways to improve efficiency and accountability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience managing commercial or industrial construction projects.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, contractors, and resources simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. construction project workflows.
  • Familiarity with International Building Code (IBC) and International Fire Code (IFC).
  • Strong project documentation and coordination experience.
  • Experience working with contractors, vendors, customers, engineers, and regulatory authorities.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.
  • Strong experience with project management systems and/or CRM platforms.
  • Excellent professional English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Exceptional organization, follow-up, and attention to detail.
  • Strong ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Self-starter with the ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Continuous-improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ERRCS, PS-DAS, BDA, RF systems, fire alarm systems, or public safety communications.
  • Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar construction management platforms.
  • Experience coordinating with Fire Departments, Building Departments, Fire Marshals, Building Inspectors, or other AHJs.
  • Experience with construction permitting and plan review processes.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based commercial construction companies.

Typical Day

A typical day may include reviewing new bid requests, researching project and AHJ requirements, updating project records, following up with contractors and vendors, coordinating RFQs and submittals, tracking permits and approvals, reviewing project documentation, communicating with customers, and updating project timelines and action items.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

jobs.title: Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems
jobs.jd_full:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture.  Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Corporate Systems Product Managemen t focuses on the internal platforms that power how Smartsheet operates - including Finance, People, Sales and Entitlements, Billing and Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation. Product Managers in this team steward product strategy, roadmaps, business workflows, and long-term platform evolution across these domains, partnering closely with Engineering and business stakeholders to translate complex enterprise needs into scalable technology outcomes.

As Group Product Manager – Corporate Systems, you will lead the Product Management function across Corporate Systems, managing and developing a team of Product Managers responsible for some of Smartsheet’s most critical internal technology domains. You will establish a cohesive product strategy across the portfolio, ensuring domain roadmaps connect to company priorities while identifying dependencies and opportunities that span traditional organizational and system boundaries.

You will operate at both the strategic and execution levels: coaching Product Managers to develop strong product practices, partnering with Engineering leadership on portfolio strategy and investment decisions, and directly engaging in the most complex cross-functional initiatives. You will help evolve Corporate Systems from a collection of enterprise applications and projects into a product-led portfolio of platforms, capabilities, data, integrations, and employee experiences designed for long-term scale.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Engineering leadership and senior stakeholders across Finance, People & Culture, Sales/GTM, Product Engineering, Data, Security, and other business functions.

You Will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for Financial Systems, People Systems, Sales & Entitlements, Billing & Monetization, Enterprise Systems Data, and AI & Automation
  • Define and evolve the product-management operating model for Corporate Systems, establishing consistent practices for product discovery, customer problem definition, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, metrics, and lifecycle management
  • Establish a cohesive portfolio strategy that connects individual product domains to Corporate Systems and company-level objectives
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to align product and technical strategy, ensuring investments balance new capabilities with platform health, reliability, scalability, security, technical debt, and operational sustainability
  • Drive portfolio-level prioritization and investment decisions across competing business needs, helping teams focus capacity on the highest-value problems and outcomes
  • Identify and manage dependencies across domains, particularly where business processes span Product, Sales, entitlements, billing, Finance, People systems, integrations, automation, and enterprise data
  • Coach Product Managers to deeply understand their customers, business processes, systems, data flows, and technical constraints rather than operating primarily as requirements or project managers
  • Raise the technical and systems fluency of the Product Management organization, enabling PMs to effectively partner with software engineers, architects, application engineers, Data teams, and Security
  • Ensure product strategies and roadmaps are grounded in measurable customer and business outcomes, with clear success metrics and mechanisms for evaluating product health and value
  • Create clarity across ambiguous or highly cross-functional initiatives where ownership, requirements, system boundaries, or desired outcomes are not immediately clear
  • Partner with senior business leaders to understand strategic priorities and translate them into coherent technology capabilities and investment plans
  • Lead product thinking for major cross-domain transformations such as new pricing and monetization models, enterprise AI adoption, ERP and billing modernization, enterprise data governance, and automation
  • Establish mechanisms for portfolio planning, roadmap reviews, product health reviews, dependency management, and executive communication across Corporate Systems
  • Ensure Product Managers balance stakeholder requests with longer-term product strategy, challenging solution-first requirements and identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, or eliminate processes
